_comment: The ally speed BURST (plan-effect-types.md C4 / D8+D9): Fly, You Fools! as a shout instead of a field - one cooldown, everybody in earshot runs. Not a new effect type: `speed_burst` learned the standard target flags in C4, so this is Swift's payload delivered through a one-shot query circle (the instant_hot/instant_resist template) rather than to the caster. ⚑ `targetsSelf` is ABSENT, which is the D9 shape and the point of the skill: the caster stays behind. A burst may author both flags - the type allows it - and this one deliberately does not. ⚑ UNCAPPED (no `selector`, no `maxTargets`), the calm precedent rather than the Sanctuary one: a shout reaches whoever can hear it, and level buys strength and duration here because the factor CAN deepen (Sanctuary had to level by breadth only because factor 0 cannot). ⚑ It pays on CAST, hit or whiff (D9, the committed-act rule) - firing it with nobody in range costs the resource and the cooldown. The bool the applier returns is not about the player's cost at all; it is what keeps a MOB's copy of this cooldown ready until an ally wanders in. ⚑ No pip beyond the ordinary green speed pip the buff store already lights on every carried ally, and no ring at all: a query circle exists for one cast and is gone (the instant_resist reasoning, D10). All values [PLACEHOLDER]: radius 3 (wider than the aura - a shout carries further than a field, and it only lands once), speedFactor 1.4 +0.05/L (1.4 -> 1.6 at L5, between the aura's 1.3 and Swift's own 1.5 because it reaches a group but does not persist), speedDurationTicks 150 +15/L = 5 s -> 7 s at 30 tps, cooldown 900 -60/L on the Retribution precedent, cost 0.03 +0.004/L, above Swift's 0.015 self-buff and below Sanctuary's 0.04 grant. Obtainable in dev via the SKILL Onward cheat; no unlock source yet (the FireVulnerability precedent), real placement comes with the content pass.
